style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: A softly lit cartoon cobalt canyon edge with coherent worn stone masses, purposeful construction and readable facets/crevices in every facing. Its exposed/end surfaces have deliberate stone character while both declared connectors remain exact and form seamless continuous native rock with the approved middle at real use sizes.
modelingFreedom: Reward useful native form, proportion, construction and purposeful detail improvements within the functional envelope.
Original part counts, blank surfaces, rectangular plates and protruding weak finished-end strata are not constraints.

A single-view ImageGen target supplies aesthetic direction; it does not establish unseen geometry, exact profiles or continuity. Do not demand target bulges or light ribbons that conflict with ports, scale or horizontal lighting symmetry.

immutableContract.identity: rock-wall-edge; blocking cobalt canyon terrain; one-cell occupied/support footprint

registration.cameraAuthority: inputs/source-camera.json and actual approved native family camera; not incidental library presentation camera
registration.processing: Same authored frame/root/scale across facings, whole-frame uniform publication reduction only; no per-view fitting, warp, recolor, painting or overhang seam repair.

contactAndEnvelope.mainContactMass: Full one-cell X/Y ground contact, without hovering body or missing support strip.
contactAndEnvelope.interpretation: Rebuild nonconnecting side/crown/end surfaces freely inside the functional contact/clearance and height budget. The original E-strip protrusion past .5 is a source inconsistency to correct, not permission for a connector overhang.

connectors.repeatAxis: native X; one world unit root spacing
connectors.requiredContinuity: Both ports preserve the approved middle shared native endpoint positions/profile, surface albedo and tangent normals. No new endcap exposure, alpha gap, crown step, perimeter seam, surface color reset, normal crease or relief beyond the joining plane may appear at either mixed-family join. Native+X end character must remain useful when exposed while the declared E port still connects.
connectors.sourceRoleResolution: Source actually declares two ports and has a decorative E-end strip. Improve exposed/end character inside the functional envelope and retain both connectors; no one-port reinterpretation.

immutableContract.lighting: No preferred horizontal light direction and no directional cast/ground shadow. Retain approved family material/capture character and one recipe across all views; softer form changes must not create a join lighting reset.

aestheticCriteria.good: Large worn stone masses/facets and coherent crown/end construction describe thick rock in N/E/S/W. The result materially improves on blank slab planes and pasted rectangular plates. Both connector profiles stay locked.

Cyan-blue upper planes, cobalt midtones and deep-blue recesses remain one family with the approved middle. Lower surfaces retain stone information instead of merging into a navy-black dead band. Avoid a visible color reset where edge meets middle.

Broad soft highlights reveal worn facets without plastic glare, neon/icy ribbons, blown whites or left/right bias. Changes of facing preserve material character and mixed joins do not reveal a lighting reset.

Broad irregular planes and restrained coherent crevices read as worn stone. Small stones/details have a purposeful relationship to the larger construction and remain native volume, without floating decals, speckle noise or thin artificial stripe artifacts.

At 128 logical and 32 phone cell pitches the major stone structure and exposed-end character remain clear. No black dead spots, coplanar shimmer, harsh plate edges, muddy merged forms, clipped corners, raster halos or unintended cast shadows. Transparent edges composite cleanly over light, gray and dark backgrounds.

The exact candidate edge and approved middle form continuous rock at both W/E joins for all facings. Independent published assemblies agree visually with a native connected reference at 128/32 pitches and representative fractional fit/panning phases, without a special border, crown seam or alpha crack.

rankedReviewPriorities.outcome: Meaningful native stone volume, construction and readable facets replace the materially blank original in all four views.
Soft cobalt color/highlight articulation reveals lower detail and purposeful end character without black bands or directional lighting.
Both exact shared connectors preserve seamless geometry/color/normal/alpha against the approved native middle, proven in current consumer sampling.

requiredEvidence.sealedPacket: Hash-bound candidate .blend, full native/publication frames, exact recipe/settings, native audit, used-resource closure and all applicable assembly/browser proofs. Candidate review starts only after a sealed packet is supplied; no approval of mutable working files.
requiredEvidence.nativeAudit: Identify actual root/intrinsic and facing transforms, registered camera matrices/calibration/pixel aspect, native/publication dimensions, evaluated bounds, contact and both connector profiles. Measure boundary positions, point/surface albedo and actual custom/corner normals against approved middle. Verify no target image plane, painted export repair, forbidden overhang, view-specific material or fitting.
requiredEvidence.portableReplay: Independently reopen the exact saved .blend from a relocated path without running the authoring recipe and render all four required native facings. Compare actual pixels and registration to packet frames; packed/native resources must close. A single replay view is insufficient.
requiredEvidence.nativeMixedAssemblies: Create an actual native connected reference from exact candidate edge and approved middle geometry at declared placements with no target cards or image compositing. For all N/E/S/W compare a separately assembled middle–edge–middle published run at exact one-unit spacing; both W and E interfaces must be visible/evaluated. Keep projection/cell scale/registration/material consistent. Include exposed/end surfaces in standalone review.
requiredEvidence.actualBrowserConsumer: Use the current actual object-review.jsx SpriteScene plus sprite-layout.js and world-sprite-raster.js at HTTP4178; wait data-world-raster-ready=true before captures. Compare independently assembled edge/middle published sprites with the connected native reference at 128px and 32px cell pitch, a representative fractional fit pitch (such as47.3), and representative fractional pan/root phases. Cover N/E/S/W, both joins, projected crown/side join regions, and alpha as well as RGB. Rerun representative/worst actual cases independently in the current browser.
requiredEvidence.compactCoverage: Use bounded parameterized cases, compact metrics/hashes, exact reproduction parameters, and retained representative/worst actual consumer captures. Inspect a small labeled set directly rather than generating huge screenshot grids; numerical residuals support but do not replace visual inspection. Light/gray/dark backgrounds are required for representative transparency/halo checks.
requiredEvidence.applicability: The current browser is the applicable consumer. Current Godot selection/manifest has34 restaurant objects and excludes underwater rock terrain, so an unused Godot bench is not required and no Godot shipping/consumer approval may be claimed. Actual Godot checks become pending if this family is later selected there.
requiredEvidence.scope: Four static frames only; animation/loop/rig tests are inapplicable. Approval is exact edge-candidate-specific and does not expand approval to sibling objects.

qualityCriteria.reviewRule: Apply frozen criteria unchanged. Meaningful visible improvement, all four views, exact locked native contract and sufficient actual mixed-join/consumer evidence are required. Missing applicable proof yields needs_evidence. Source differences alone are not defects. Scores are comparative, with no automatic numerical pass threshold. Report at most three ranked material blockers with visible desired outcomes.
